decisions.decision: Embed a generated Info.plist in the command-line helper.
decisions.rationale: This makes Xcode and codesign derive the canonical reverse-DNS helper identifier without manual post-signing or stored credentials.

decisions.decision: Keep the Homebrew cask disabled until the corrected notarized artifact exists.
decisions.rationale: The published cask must use an immutable release URL and SHA-256 for an artifact that passes the complete release verifier.

assumptions: The user will use the newly opened fixed archive rather than the older installed notarized app.
The release tag will be v1.0.0 once the corrected artifact passes notarization and Gatekeeper.
blockers: The user must select the fixed archive in Xcode Organizer, choose Distribute App > Developer ID > Upload, wait for Ready to distribute, and export the notarized app.
risks: Selecting the older archive or packaging the current /Applications copy would reintroduce the wrong helper identifier.
Publishing before the immutable release asset exists would make the Homebrew cask unverifiable.
next_steps: Run Scripts/Distribution/verify-release on the exported app and require a complete pass.
Create a versioned zip, compute SHA-256, publish GitHub release v1.0.0, activate the cask with the immutable asset URL and checksum, push the tap, and run a clean brew install smoke test.
recommended_first_action: In Xcode Organizer, confirm the selected archive was created around 17:53 and upload that fixed archive to the Apple notary service.
